Out-Of-Core construction of Sparse Voxel Octrees
Using Morton codes For the second approach, the goals were speed and a better memory layout. In my search for that last feature, I stumbled upon the Morton order / Z-order curve, which is a way to encode multidimensional data into a one-dimensional array, which preserves data locality on multiple levels.
